# Quntam Gen

> Quntam Gen is a digital growth agency offering web development, SEO, digital marketing, Meta ads management, social media handling, app development, AI automation, UI/UX design, and custom software development as one coordinated service.

- [About](https://quntamgen.com/about): Who we are and how we work
- [Blog](https://quntamgen.com/blog): Guides on SEO, web performance, and AI automation
